name: Tommy
description: A detailed character concept sheet for a futuristic race car driver, showcasing a high-performance racing suit crafted from matte black and crimson red leather. The central figure stands confidently in full gear including black leather boots, wearing a sleek aerodynamic helmet with a striking, highly reflective red chrome visor that completely hides their face and mirrors the dramatic track lights.
rules: An original character: no likeness of any real person, film, comic, game or franchise character, no logo or emblem. No logos, printed text, brand marks or patches; plain straps; no resemblance to any real person. A distinct silhouette: a clearly different build, hair and outfit shape from other characters. Real fabrics, not plastic or latex; natural skin.
